name: Hiya

search.notes: Lookups only work inside the mobile app, so the agent cannot check whether the number is listed. Hiya also powers caller ID on some carrier and phone maker apps.

steps: Draft a deletion request that names the phone number with country code and any name Hiya shows for it.
Send it to dpo@hiya.com, with support@hiya.com in copy.
Answer any identity check from the same email address.
Record the date sent and follow up after 30 days.
optout.notes: No public unlist form was found on 2026-10-27. The app privacy policy lists dpo@hiya.com and support@hiya.com and says Hiya may ask for more information to confirm identity.

verification_note: Privacy policy loaded on 2026-10-27. The guessed URL hiya.com/optout returned 404.
